WITH title_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, title
    FROM title
    WHERE production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1984
),
person_volker AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT person_id, info_type_id
    FROM person_info
    WHERE note = 'Volker Boehm'
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS of_person,
       MIN(t.title) AS biography_movie
FROM title_matches AS t
JOIN movie_link AS ml ON ml.linked_movie_id = t.id
JOIN link_type AS lt ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id AND lt.link = 'features'
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.movie_id = t.id AND ci.movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
JOIN person_volker AS pi ON pi.person_id = ci.person_id
JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = pi.info_type_id AND it.info = 'mini biography'
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id AND n.gender = 'm' AND n.name_pcode_cf LIKE 'D%'
JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = n.id AND an.name LIKE '%a%'
